description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) class representing overdue loan information within the Fineract platform. It encapsulates details about a loan that is overdue, including whether interest recalculation should be run, the date from which recalculation starts, and the date of the last charge applied.

classes.name: LoanOverdueDTO
classes.description: DTO for encapsulating overdue loan details and related metadata.

methods.name: LoanOverdueDTO
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields related to overdue loan information.

methods.name: isRunInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Returns whether interest recalculation should be run for this overdue loan.

methods.name: getLoan
methods.description: Returns the loan object associated with this DTO.

methods.name: getRecalculateFrom
methods.description: Returns the date from which interest recalculation should start.

methods.name: getLastChargeAppliedDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the last charge applied to the loan.
